title: Stir-Fried Udon Noodles
description: A classic Chinese dish that combines the flavors of earthy udon noodles with vibrant vegetables and a hint of Japanese flair.
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package instructions.
Cut the sweet potatoes and bell peppers into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp of veggie oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sweet potatoes and bell peppers and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked udon noodles and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Mix in the soy sauce and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
